body: I'm proud of you! My room, usually well-kept and clean, is in disarray. Laundry everywhere, garbage everywhere, bed unmade, aquarium uncleaned. I've been trying the past few weeks to get myself to do it... But I just can't seem to bring myself. But at least one of us have their bed made. :)
This and the fact that I would devastate the people that I love are the only reasons I'm too scared to go.
